in_hebrew.name: יֹתָם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יֹתָם הוא שם עברי שמקורו בשם יהוה ומשמעותו 'ה' הוא שלם וצדיק'. השם מורכב מ'יו' ו'תָם', שפירושו תמים וצדיק. בהקשר המקראי, יֹתָם היה בנו של עוזיהו ומלך יהודה.

in_greek.name: Ιωθάμ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιωθάμ είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος יֹתָם, που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι τέλειος' ή 'ο Θεός είναι δίκαιος'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, δεν αναφέρεται συγκεκριμένα, αλλά το όνομα σχετίζεται με τη θεολογική σημασία της δικαιοσύνης και της τελειότητας του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Iotham
in_latin.long_meaning: Iotham est nomen hebraicum quod significat 'Deus est perfectus' vel 'Deus est justus'. In traditione christiana, nomen Iotham refertur ad regem Iuda qui fuit filius Oziae et pater Achaz.

in_english.name: Jotham
in_english.meaning: God is perfect or God is righteous
in_english.long_meaning: Jotham is a Hebrew name that means 'God is perfect' or 'God is righteous'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'Yah' (God) and 'tam' (perfect or righteous). In the Bible, Jotham was the son of Uzziah and king of Judah. The name signifies spiritual perfection and divine justice, reflecting a deep connection to God's character.

biblical_reference.note: Jotham was a king of Judah, son of Uzziah and father of Ahaz.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jotham holds a significant place in Jewish history. Being the eldest son of King Jeroboam II, Jotham is known for his role in preserving and furthering the Jewish kingdom during a time of political instability. His name is a constant reminder of God's continued presence and guidance in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: Jotham's name carries a deep spiritual meaning for those who seek a closer relationship with God. It serves as a reminder that God is actively involved in our lives, working to perfect us in every way. This name encourages us to trust in God's plan for us, even when we face challenges and uncertainty. By embracing the name Jotham, we make a commitment to live our lives in a manner that reflects the perfection of God.
